description: A ground-level photograph depicting agricultural infrastructure for a greenhouse or similar crop cultivation in Almería, Andalusia, Spain, from 2009. The image shows a dense grid of vertical support poles forming an overhead structure, extending across an expanse of dry, bare ground. A dark, coarse mesh net is visible in the lower foreground, forming part of the enclosure. In the distant background, faint mountains are visible under a clear, bright blue sky. The image explicitly credits "Eurostat LUCAS 2009" in the bottom left corner and in the caption. This visual illustrates the infrastructure of greenhouses, even when covers might be open or absent, as per Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) nomenclature guidelines.
